name: Roque de los Muchachos Observatory
place: Roque de los Muchachos, La Palma, Canary Islands
description: An observatory of the Instituto de Astrofisica de Canarias on La Palma, opened in 1985, hosting telescopes from Britain, the Netherlands, Spain and other countries. Its largest is the 10.4 m Gran Telescopio Canarias.
highlights: The Gran Telescopio Canarias had first light on 13 July 2007 and was inaugurated on 24 July 2009 by King Juan Carlos I.
It was described as the world's largest single-aperture optical telescope, with 36 hexagonal mirror segments.
The site also has the William Herschel Telescope and the Swedish 1-m Solar Telescope with adaptive optics.
